mapper.sql: FROM arbitration_case a JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=a.rental_order_id LEFT JOIN admin_case_relation r ON r.relation_type='arbitration_case' AND r.relation_id=a.id AND r.is_primary=1 LEFT JOIN admin_case c ON c.id=r.admin_case_id AND c.case_type='arbitration' LEFT JOIN claim_user_response u ON u.claim_id=a.claim_id AND u.response_type='appeal'

SELECT a.id,o.id order_id,o.order_no,o.factory_id,o.buyer_user_id buyer_id, (SELECT MIN(s.factory_name_snapshot) FROM checkout_batch_item_snapshot s WHERE s.checkout_batch_id=o.checkout_batch_id AND s.factory_id=o.factory_id) factory_name, a.version,a.created_at,a.case_no,a.case_status status,a.claim_id,a.source_issue_report_id issue_id,u.response_remark appeal_reason,c.id case_id, k.operation_reason request,k.request_payload_json->>'$.party' party
LEFT JOIN admin_case_action k ON k.id=( SELECT latest.id FROM admin_case_action latest WHERE latest.admin_case_id=c.id AND latest.action_type='requestArbitrationEvidence' ORDER BY CAST(latest.request_payload_json->>'$.expectedVersion' AS UNSIGNED) DESC,latest.created_at DESC,latest.id DESC LIMIT 1)

choose.when: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_decision d WHERE d.confirmed_case_guard=a.id)
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_decision d WHERE d.confirmed_case_guard=a.id)

mapper.select: ORDER BY a.created_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{pageQuery.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageQuery.offset}
SELECT arbitration_case_id case_id, evidence_record_id evidence_id FROM arbitration_evidence_link WHERE arbitration_case_id IN AND evidence_role=#{role} ORDER BY arbitration_case_id,id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_evidence_link WHERE arbitration_case_id=#{id} AND evidence_record_id=#{evidenceId})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case a JOIN order_evidence_record e ON e.rental_order_id=a.rental_order_id AND e.id=#{id} AND e.draft_removed_at IS NULL WHERE a.id=#{arbitration} AND (e.issue_report_id=a.source_issue_report_id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_evidence_link l WHERE l.arbitration_case_id=a.id AND l.evidence_record_id=e.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_relation ar JOIN admin_case_relation s ON s.admin_case_id=ar.admin_case_id AND s.relation_role='source' AND s.is_primary=0 JOIN admin_case_relation parent ON parent.is_primary=1 AND parent.relation_id=s.relation_id AND parent.relation_type=CASE s.relation_type WHEN 'receipt_problem' THEN 'order_issue_report' WHEN 'overdue_impact' THEN 'fulfillment_risk' ELSE s.relation_type END JOIN admin_case_relation proof ON proof.admin_case_id=parent.admin_case_id AND proof.relation_type='order_evidence_record' WHERE ar.relation_type='arbitration_case' AND ar.relation_id=a.id AND ar.is_primary=1 AND proof.relation_id=e.id)))

SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case a JOIN admin_case_relation r ON r.relation_type='arbitration_case' AND r.relation_id=a.id AND r.is_primary=1 JOIN admin_case_relation s ON s.admin_case_id=r.admin_case_id AND s.relation_role='source' AND s.is_primary=0 AND s.relation_type=#{type} AND s.relation_id=#{source}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_issue_report WHERE id=#{source} AND rental_order_id=#{order} AND issue_status IN ('submitted','processing','waiting_evidence')) EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_fulfillment_risk WHERE id=#{source} AND source_rental_order_id=#{order} AND risk_status!='resolved') EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_intervention_record WHERE id=#{source} AND rental_order_id=#{order} AND intervention_status IN ('open','processing'))
mapper.update: UPDATE order_receipt_check c JOIN rental_order_delivery l ON l.rental_order_id=c.rental_order_id SET c.remaining_check_ms=COALESCE(c.remaining_check_ms,GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,GREATEST(c.start_at,#{at}),c.deadline_at) DIV 1000),43200000), c.check_status='problem_reported',c.deadline_at=NULL,c.version=c.version+1,c.updated_at=#{at},l.receipt_check_deadline_at=NULL,l.updated_at=#{at} WHERE c.rental_order_id=#{order} AND c.check_status='pending'
UPDATE order_issue_report SET issue_status='transferred_arbitration',fulfillment_effect='paused',version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND rental_order_id=#{order}
UPDATE order_issue_report SET issue_status='resolved',resolved_at=#{at},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{issue} AND issue_status='transferred_arbitration'
mapper.sql: SELECT o.deposit_paid_amount_fen paid_fen, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_fen),0) FROM order_deduction WHERE rental_order_id=o.id AND fund_component='deposit' AND deduction_status IN ('pending','confirmed')) deducted_fen, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deposit_refund_amount_fen),0) FROM refund_order WHERE rental_order_id=o.id AND refund_status='success') refunded_fen, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deposit_refund_amount_fen),0) FROM refund_order WHERE rental_order_id=o.id AND refund_status NOT IN ('cancelled','success')) reserved_fen,o.id order_id FROM rental_order o

SELECT r.id,r.rental_order_item_id item_id,r.sku_id,r.sn_id,r.quantity,r.reservation_status status,i.prop_name_snapshot name,s.sn_code,r.rental_order_id order_id FROM inventory_reservation r JOIN rental_order_item i ON i.id=r.rental_order_item_id LEFT JOIN prop_sn_instance s ON s.id=r.sn_id
mapper.select: WHERE r.rental_order_id=#{order} AND r.source_type!='extension_request' AND reservation_status IN ('paid_locked','renting','overdue_holding','disputed_holding') ORDER BY r.id
WHERE r.rental_order_id IN AND r.source_type!='extension_request' AND reservation_status IN ('paid_locked','renting','overdue_holding','disputed_holding') ORDER BY r.id
mapper.sql: SELECT id,decision_status status,responsibility_party responsibility,decision_summary summary, confirmed_loss_amount_fen loss,deposit_deduction_amount_fen deposit,excess_compensation_amount_fen excess,rent_deduction_amount_fen rent,refund_components_json refunds, stock_outcomes_json stock,decided_at confirmed_at,compensation_receivable_id receivable, (SELECT ac.request_payload_json->>'$.refundBasis' FROM admin_case_action ac WHERE ac.target_id=arbitration_decision.id AND ac.action_type='arbitration_draft' LIMIT 1) refund_basis, arbitration_case_id case_id, (SELECT p.failure_message FROM admin_case_action p WHERE p.target_id=arbitration_decision.id AND p.target_type='arbitration_decision' AND p.action_type='execute_arbitration' AND p.action_status='failed') failure_reason FROM arbitration_decision
mapper.select: WHERE arbitration_case_id=#{id} AND decision_status IN ('draft','confirmed') ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

WHERE arbitration_case_id IN AND id=(SELECT d.id FROM arbitration_decision d WHERE d.arbitration_case_id=arbitration_decision.arbitration_case_id AND d.decision_status IN ('draft','confirmed') ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id DESC LIMIT 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE arbitration_decision SET decision_status='cancelled',updated_at=#{at} WHERE arbitration_case_id=#{id} AND decision_status='draft'
UPDATE arbitration_decision SET decision_status='confirmed',confirm_request_id=#{key},decided_by_admin_user_id=#{actor},decided_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND decision_status='draft'
UPDATE arbitration_decision SET compensation_receivable_id=#{receivable} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM order_deduction WHERE source_type='arbitration' AND source_id=#{id} AND deduction_status='confirmed' ORDER BY id

SELECT a.target_type relation_type,a.target_id relation_id FROM admin_case_action a JOIN admin_case_action p ON p.id=a.parent_action_id WHERE p.target_type='arbitration_decision' AND p.target_id=#{id} AND p.action_type='execute_arbitration' ORDER BY a.step_no
SELECT id FROM admin_case_action WHERE target_type='arbitration_decision' AND target_id=#{id} AND action_type='execute_arbitration'

SELECT p.target_id decision_id, a.target_type relation_type,a.target_id relation_id,r.refund_status,r.refund_amount_fen refund_fen FROM admin_case_action p JOIN admin_case_action a ON a.parent_action_id=p.id LEFT JOIN refund_order r ON a.target_type='refund_order' AND a.target_id=r.id WHERE p.target_type='arbitration_decision' AND p.action_type='execute_arbitration' AND p.target_id IN ORDER BY p.target_id,a.step_no
SELECT id,action_type kind,target_id target,request_payload_json payload, action_status status,operator_admin_user_id actor FROM admin_case_action WHERE parent_action_id=#{parent} ORDER BY step_no
SELECT id FROM arbitration_case WHERE id>#{after} AND case_status IN ('executing','execution_failed') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
